ALO is seeking a brand-new Regional Asset Protection Manager to lead and scale our Asset Protection (AP) function across Australia and New Zealand. This role will be based in Sydney, Australia.

This pivotal role will support the brand’s mission to elevate mindfulness and movement by safeguarding our sanctuaries, teams, and assets. Partnering with global AP leadership and regional counterparts, you will adapt and execute ALO’s global Asset Protection strategy across Australia and New Zealand, tailoring programs to local risks, regulatory requirements, and business needs while maintaining alignment with global standards.

This role will support an expanding retail portfolio and lead omnichannel investigations across retail, e-commerce, fulfilment, and supply chain operations in both markets. You will also partner with the department responsible for Health & Safety to support workplace safety initiatives.
